QuestInfo.name: The Lost Treasure
QuestInfo.0: Neinheart says he has something urgent to ask of you...
QuestInfo.1: The Black Wings aren't out of Ereve yet, so you must search everywhere for the lost treasure. Focus your search on #m130010010#, #m130010020#, and #m130010120#.\r\n\r\nThe problem is that #o9300743# can take the form of other people, so you must talk to everyone to make sure they're not an impostor.
QuestInfo.2: You defeated the Black Wing members #o9300743# and #p1104001# and recovered the lost treasure.

0.0: You've heard of the Black Wings, right? They are, for lack of a better term, our arch-nemeses. One of them entered Ereve and stole a very important treasure.
0.1: Shinsoo's power keeps evil at bay, yet #r#o9300743# #p1104001# was able to walk right into our town. Our defenses can never be perfect, particularly when our enemies can change form.
0.2: Still, I cannot imagine the cur will have gotten far.

yes.0: A #o9300743# will be smart enough to change into another of the senior knights, but you must look past the outer appearance. #rYou will realize something is wrong when you talk with them.#k Concentrate, and you may be of use.

no.0: Is this too much for a Knight-in-Training? Your Empress needs you.

1.0: Did you defeat #o9300743# #p1104001#? I might have taken you too lightly.

item.0: We must recover that treasure. The #o9300743# has not escaped Ereve. Search every corner, talk to every knight. Return when you have the #b#t4032101##k. Make sure to search #m130010010#, #m130010020#, and #m130010120#.
